items.briefing:
A cyber operation has been identified targeting South Korean media and automotive sectors, a reminder that state-linked attacks across the Asia Pacific region can have ripple effects for Australian organisations with supply chain or business ties to Korea. Separately, a new report highlights that Asia Pacific customers — including Australians — are increasingly prioritising fraud protection over transaction speed when sending money internationally, reflecting growing awareness of financial scams.

For Australian organisations, cybersecurity experts are emphasising the importance of "containment" strategies to limit damage when a breach occurs, rather than relying solely on prevention.

**Practical tip:** Make sure your organisation has a clear plan for isolating affected systems quickly if a cyber incident occurs — knowing who to call and what to shut down first can significantly reduce the damage.
